verse.verse_1: Indeed, there came upon the human a period of time when he was an unremembered thing.
verse.verse_2: We have created the human from a (sperm) drop, a mixture, testing him; We made him to hear and see.
verse.verse_3: Indeed, We have guided him to the path, he is either grateful or ungrateful.
verse.verse_4: Indeed, for the unbelievers We have prepared chains, fetters and a Blazing (Fire).
verse.verse_5: But the righteous shall drink of a goblet mixed with camphor;
verse.verse_6: a fountain at which the worshipers of Allah drink and make it gush forth abundantly;
verse.verse_7: they who keep their vows and fear a Day whose evil is spread;
verse.verse_8: who give food, for the love of Him to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
verse.verse_9: (saying): 'We feed you only desirous of the Face of Allah; we seek of you neither recompense nor thanks,
verse.verse_10: for we fear from our Lord a stern, frownful Day'
verse.verse_11: So Allah will save them from the evil of that Day and has secured for them radiance and joyfulness,
verse.verse_12: and recompense them for their patience with a Garden, and robes of silk.
verse.verse_13: Reclining there upon couches, they shall see neither the sun nor the moon.
verse.verse_14: Near them shall be its shades with its clusters hung gently down,
verse.verse_15: and passed around them shall be silver vessels, and crystal goblets,
verse.verse_16: goblets of silver that they have precisely measured.
verse.verse_17: And they shall be given to drink from a cup whose mixture is ginger,
verse.verse_19: Immortal youths will go about them, when you see them, you would suppose them to be scattered pearls.
verse.verse_20: When you see them, you see bliss, and a great Kingdom.
verse.verse_21: Upon them there will be garments of green silk, rich brocade, and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them a pure beverage to drink.
verse.verse_22: 'See, this is your recompense, your striving is thanked'
verse.verse_23: We have indeed, sent down to you the Koran, a (clear) sending,
verse.verse_24: therefore be patient under the Judgement of your Lord, and do not obey either the sinner or the unbeliever.
verse.verse_25: And, remember the Name of your Lord at the dawn and in the evening;
verse.verse_26: and in the night prostrate to Him; and exalt Him for a long night.
verse.verse_27: Indeed, these love the hasty life, and are heedless and leave behind them a heavy Day.
verse.verse_28: We created them, and We strengthened their joints, but, when We will, We shall indeed exchange their likes.
verse.verse_29: This is indeed a Reminder, so that he who will, takes a path to his Lord.
verse.verse_30: Yet you will not unless Allah wills; surely, Allah is the Knower, the Wise.
verse.verse_31: He is Merciful to whom He will; but, for the harmdoers He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
